name: Lectures 1–7 test set v1

scoring.policy: Same scoring as the dev and held-out sets. Unanswerables stay out of retrieval metrics and are used for abstention checks.

label_notes: Frozen test set. Don't look at per-question results while changing the system; run it once per finished change and report the totals.

Written after the dev and held-out results were known. Gold chunks cover most units that neither earlier set uses; several 'Which exercise...' questions test lookup only, since the notes state exercises without solutions.

T35–T40 are unanswerable. T36 and T37 are covered in Lectures 8 and 11, which exist in lectures/ but are outside the index. T40 is a near miss: Lecture 7 covers coordinates but not change-of-basis matrices.
Gold IDs are designated evidence targets, not exhaustive relevance judgments.
